args.title: Brightline Freight: freight pricing this quarter — combined summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Brightline Freight's latest newsletter highlights "Freight pricing this quarter," linking to a blog article plus a free-registration companion piece (registered with mei.novak@northwind.example).
- Article: Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
